# Caring for Caregivers

> Caring for Caregivers (C4C) is a student-led 501(c)(3) nonprofit supporting the wellness of healthcare providers and raising awareness about healthcare burnout through community events, education, research, and wellness initiatives. 300+ volunteers across 7 chapters, $14,000+ raised, 200+ providers served.

## Pages

- [Home](https://caring4caregivers.org): Overview of the mission, chapters, and ways to get involved.
- [About Us](https://caring4caregivers.org/about): Who we are, our mission, and our team and advisory board.
- [Chapters](https://caring4caregivers.org/chapters): Chapters in Irvine, Mission Viejo, New York, Bay Area, Toronto, Taiwan, and Uganda.
- [Impact](https://caring4caregivers.org/impact): Healthcare burnout context and our by-the-numbers results.
- [Partners](https://caring4caregivers.org/partners): Organizations and sponsors we work with.
- [Donate](https://caring4caregivers.org/donate): Give to fund care packages, community events, and awareness.
- [Contact](https://caring4caregivers.org/contact): How to reach us and our chapters.
